$comment: Sanitization gate config for swarm-map, which is also the canonical HOME of the gate (scripts/check_sanitization.py + .github/workflows/sanitization-gate.yml). This file carries only swarm-map's own particulars; the detection machinery is shared by every repo that calls the gate.
package_kind: SHARED base package of the Swarm Map agent platform, which ships to EVERY downstream deployment
$comment_prefixes: infra/templates/ holds the base plugins, skills and hooks shipped to every agent; docs/ holds runbooks and templates; SOUL matches any top-level base soul template. Top-level *.md (README, CONTRIBUTING) are always included automatically.

semantic.domain_noun: downstream deployment, investigation, customer, or operator instance
flag_examples: names of real individuals (investigation subjects, suspects, targets, customers, end-users, or named staff)
organizations or companies tied to a specific investigation or customer (NOT the publishing project itself)
document IDs, file names, dataset names, case numbers, or URLs specific to one investigation / customer / use case
a codename or label identifying a particular investigation / customer / case
operator- or instance-specific infrastructure identifiers: specific hostnames, chat/group IDs, server addresses or ports, account numbers, phone numbers
dates, locations, or details that only make sense for one specific downstream use case
do_not_flag_examples: the publishing org/project, its products and repos: cyborg-garden / cyborg.garden, and the former org names it was published under, which still appear throughout historical content: NimbleCo / NimbleCoAI / NimbleCoOrg / nimbleco.ai

Hermes, Swarm Map / SM / swarm-map, the former names Hermes Swarm Map / HSM / hermes-swarm-map, hermes-agent and its published multi-tenant fork hermes-agent-mt, this repo's own name and its GitHub URLs
the platform's own architecture, design, roadmap, plans, and contributor docs
generic tool / API / platform / model / provider names and public reference material
extra_instructions: This package MAY, and naturally does, describe the platform itself. Prefer NOT flagging the platform's own project identity, but DO flag anything that looks like it came from a specific investigation, customer, or operator instance.

deterministic.$comment_allow_substrings: The placeholder email domains swarm-map's pre-canonical gate hardcoded. Matched against the detected value only, never the whole line.
deterministic.$comment_relaxations: Carried over from swarm-map's pre-canonical gate: only globally routable IPv4 counts (private, CGNAT, loopback, link-local and RFC 5737 documentation ranges are fixtures in infra code), and NANP 555 numbers are documentation placeholders. Both default OFF in the canonical gate.
deterministic.$comment_skip_paths: Test code that holds credential-SHAPED fixtures on purpose. The gate accepts only test-fixture paths here (fixture dirs or test files); keep this tight.
deterministic.$comment_allow_exact: Exact values (never substrings), each verified in place: '+1234567890' is a UI placeholder in components/surfaces/platform-ui.ts; the letta connection string is the commented example in docker/letta-compose.yml (user and password are both the service name); the three dotted quads are SVG path coordinates in public/*.svg, not addresses.
deterministic.$comment_allow_fixture_tokens: The four ghp_/github_pat_ values are alphabet-sequence fakes in lib/services/__tests__ (keys, keys-env-sync, redact-secrets). Provider-token shapes are reported even inside skip_paths, so fixture fakes are listed here exactly.
